about_the_game:
SUCK WITH STYLE. BLOW WITH PURPOSE. CLEAN WITH CHAOS!

Take control of ACUVAC — a physics-driven canister vacuum with a mind of its own — in a destructive cleaning adventure. Use your hose to suck up, blow away, and manipulate the world around you in unexpected ways. Uncover and clean every corner of this whimsical, robot-run world where anything goes, and chaos is all part of the fun!

GAMEPLAY INSPIRED BY:

  • Katamari Damacy – Engage in playful large-scale object interaction paired with satisfying physics-based gameplay. Similar to Katamari: All objects are is disposable!

  • Luigi’s Mansion – Use precision suction and airflow mechanics to manipulate the environment, open up cupboards, collect hidden stuff, and clean out everything.

  • Octodad: Dadliest Catch – Control a flexible, limb-like hose that bends and swings, physically interacting with objects and obstacles in a fun, silly, and memorable way.

  • It separates itself from those three games with more consistent controls that are difficult to learn but easy to master. With a higher skill ceiling and lots of content, you're sure to feel satisfied and get that bang for your buck!

WHAT YOU'LL DO:

  • CLEAN:
    Vacuum trash, smash objects, and creatively interact with environments to complete objectives. Be the overachiever and super-clean the level, clearing out every object in sight.

  • COLLECT:
    Every unique object collected gets added to your own residence (Yes, ACUVAC has their own house!) Unlock new levels, arcade machines, and quirky cosmetics by earning medals and discovering hidden collectibles.

  • CONQUER:
    Master every challenge across varied sandbox levels. Take on unique tasks, unlock special bonus levels, and compete in local-multiplayer modes. There's plenty of challenge and lots of different surprises to uncover!

WISHLIST IT!

Experience one of the most creative, chaotic, and satisfying physics-based adventures. Add ACUVAC: A Suck and Blow Adventure to your Wishlist today and get ready to turn cleaning into chaos!

short_description: Suck! Blow! Swing your hose around! In this physics-based action-adventure, you'll become ACUVAC, the world's most chaotic canister vacuum. Smash, clean, and overachieve your way through ridiculous challenges in a robot-run world. Cleaning has never been this messy — or this much fun!
